decisions.rationale: "familial aniridia" names a single defined form of the disease (aniridia) linked to one specific definition, so it is a Specific Disease. The familial qualifier is kept because it marks a particular form, as with 'classical galactosemia'.

decisions.rationale: "WAGR complex" is the abbreviation for one specific syndrome (Wilms tumor, aniridia, genitourinary abnormalities, mental retardation). It is a single defined disease, so it is annotated as a Specific Disease separately from its long form.
